entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Tests are coming up. How's[n]your studying going?

entries.speaker: Kasumi

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: If it's all right with you,[n]could we study together?
entries.uk: Якщо ти не проти,[n]можемо повчитися разом?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What's the plan? Are you going to study[n]with Kasumi?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thank you! This is going to[n]help so much!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'll be waiting at the diner[n]in Shibuya.
